/task occupancy — Administratively release one authoritative local occupancy claim.

  Purpose: Administratively release one authoritative local occupancy claim.
  Usage:  /task occupancy --release #N

  Arguments:
    --release #N
        Issue-scoped administrative release.
    --release #N
        release exactly one issue-scoped local claim

  Preconditions:
    An exact numeric issue and --release are required; --steal is unavailable.

  Effects:
    Releases one main-worktree-anchored local occupancy claim without changing issue lifecycle state.

  Output:
    Prints the released provider, session prefix, and worktree, or reports that no claim exists.

  Exit codes:
    0  success (or idempotent no-op)
    1  runtime error (message on stderr)
    2  usage error / unknown verb

  Examples:
    /task occupancy --release #1325

  Related:
    fleet
    stop
